name: gpt-image-2-assets
description: Design-first UI pipeline: establish a design language, generate a static mockup for approval, then build the interface and produce every background and icon through a local or hosted multi-model MCP image service (GPT Image 2, Qwen Image, Seedream). Bundles the ui-design-studio, gpt-image-2-assets, and ui-ux-asset-pipeline skills. Connects to the MCP server declared in .mcp.json (defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000/mcp).
